prompt:
Refine this exact blue ghost-armored guard in the project's clean GEM ICON style. Main correction is the HUMAN BEARD and HEAD SILHOUETTE.

REMOVE COMPLETELY the white/ivory diamond-shaped patch from the human chin beard. Fill with natural solid dark charcoal beard color. NO white streak, white beard tip, diamond, silver patch or decorative highlight in the beard.

REDESIGN THE BEARD CONTOUR:
One strong readable near-black/charcoal jaw-and-chin beard mass that follows a broad squared jaw then tapers into ONE short clean blunt point. At most one broad muted charcoal side plane. No long skinny triangular beard, many spikes, individual hairs, random facets or internal stripes. Thick simple moustache integrated naturally above it with two restrained ends; keep the mouth as one small firm line, not a big exposed patch.
The outline should separate clearly from the blue chest and pale mane collar: retain a small visible warm neck/under-jaw plane and quiet dark contour, move only the nearest collar tuft a little outward if necessary to avoid a tangled beard/collar junction. Do not draw a glowing outline. Keep the beard compact enough that the chin and head shape remain readable.

FACE/HAIR:
Preserve adult male identity, stern expression, head size, face direction, warm skin and bold simple brows/eyes. Face uses one broad skin base plus a single clear side shadow. Clean slightly stronger outer silhouette around cheek/jaw and broad hair locks, fewer internal boundaries. No realistic eyes/wrinkles or tiny triangular skin facets. Hair retains black shape and topknot; no new ornaments.

OVERALL ICON CLEANUP:
Keep large blue/navy armor planes, steel edges, huge guardian-mask shoulder and limited cyan ghost-flame accents. A few coherent matte value masses and confident dark outlines, avoid any added fragments or fine texture. Do not redesign armor or change pose/proportions/colors. Both hands remain EMPTY, no weapon or shield. Keep pale collar and ghost curls as existing broad shapes, only minimal adjustment near jaw for clarity.
Same full-body square composition, full boots and highest shoulder ornament in frame, plain warm ivory background, no text, frame or extra items.
Result must show a clean SOLID DARK beard with a clearer broad head/jaw silhouette and no white beard patch.
purpose: Remove ivory beard patch, strengthen solid dark beard/jaw silhouette and refine icon clarity without adding detail.
visual_review: White beard patch removed; beard forms a solid dark grouped silhouette with clearer separation from collar and neck. Blue armor and unarmed pose retained.
